title: From Structure to Validity: Mechanism-Guided Generation and Refinement of LLM Rubrics
abstract: arXiv:2610.13375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubrics have been widely used to evaluate and optimize language models on open-ended tasks. However, existing work primarily focuses on generating better rubrics, with limited understanding of what makes rubric design effective. In this work, we conduct a systematic mechanistic analysis of rubric design across criterion organization, criterion operationalization, and score aggregation. Our analysis shows that structural organization enables more comprehensive criterion construction, semantic specification alone does not ensure effective criterion-level judgments, and sophisticated score aggregation provides limited additional gains. Guided by these findings, we introduce Adaptive Rubric Tree Search with Hybrid refinement (ARTS-Hybrid), which combines adaptive tree construction with semantic-first, response-calibrated refinement. translated_title: 从结构到有效性：机制引导的大语言模型评分量规生成与优化
translated_abstract: 评分量规已被广泛用于评估和优化语言模型在开放式任务上的表现。然而，现有工作主要聚焦于如何生成更好的量规，对于什么样的量规设计才是有效的缺乏深入理解。在这项工作中，我们围绕标准组织、标准操作化和分数聚合三个维度，对量规设计进行了系统的机制分析。分析结果表明：结构化的组织方式有助于构建更全面的标准；仅靠语义描述并不足以保证有效的标准级判断；而复杂的分数聚合只能带来有限的额外收益。基于这些发现，我们提出了带有混合精炼的自适应量规树搜索方法（ARTS-Hybrid），它将自适应树构建与“语义优先、响应校准”的精炼策略相结合。在多个基准上的实验表明，ARTS-Hybrid 同时提升了端到端评估性能和量规的内在质量。
tldr: 该研究系统揭示了LLM评分量规设计的有效机制——结构化的标准组织最为关键，并据此提出ARTS-Hybrid方法，通过自适应量规树构建与语义优先、响应校准的精炼策略，同时提升了端到端评估性能与量规的内在质量。
en_tdlr: This work systematically uncovers what makes LLM rubric design effective—showing that structural criterion organization matters most—and proposes ARTS-Hybrid, which combines adaptive rubric tree construction with semantic-first, response-calibrated refinement to improve both end-to-end evaluation performance and rubric quality.
